preflight.target_transport: AWS SSM to verified EC2; local kubeconfig kind context was not used

capacity_after_install.measurement_limitation: single point shortly after install; not a peak or adoption capacity forecast

private_access.certificate_note: curl used --insecure because Argo CD generated a self-signed certificate; this smoke validates the endpoint response, not certificate identity or trust

failures_and_adjustments.symptom: local kubectl default context reported kind-lynk-cluster v1.30
failures_and_adjustments.cause: laptop kubeconfig was not the Lynk EC2 target
failures_and_adjustments.resolution: did not mutate kind; pinned Ansible inventory to the verified EC2 instance and checked K3s through SSM

failures_and_adjustments.symptom: initial node requests parser failed on quantity suffix 10M
failures_and_adjustments.cause: ad-hoc parser did not handle all Kubernetes quantity formats
failures_and_adjustments.resolution: used kubectl describe node allocated-resources output as authoritative

failures_and_adjustments.symptom: full server-side dry-run returned NotFound for argocd namespace
failures_and_adjustments.cause: API dry-run does not persist the Namespace object before validating namespaced objects
failures_and_adjustments.resolution: created only the previously absent empty namespace, then reran the full server-side dry-run successfully

failures_and_adjustments.symptom: Ansible SSM connection could not reach AWS SSO from default sandbox
failures_and_adjustments.resolution: reran through the approved network-enabled execution environment

failures_and_adjustments.symptom: argocd-server initially reported missing Redis secret/connection refused
failures_and_adjustments.cause: Redis secret and endpoint were still initializing during rollout
failures_and_adjustments.resolution: observed Redis endpoint appear; server became Ready and all seven workloads passed rollout

limitations: Argo CD 3.5 official tested Kubernetes matrix lists 1.36 through 1.33; K3s 1.37.1 is outside that matrix.
Initial controller health check is not workload adoption proof or a long-duration stability test.
Argo CD remains non-HA and is not production resilient to node failure.
No Application, adoption, self-heal, prune, or delivery enablement occurred in CP12.
